note: bars set from the first measured run (see the PR); aliasing barred for tones to 8 kHz. The integrator is the exponential one of common/dsp tape.h (tabulated Langevin, one substep per sample in eco, up to four in standard and high), held to the double-precision RK4 reference at 512 substeps: 1e-4 FS everywhere but eco at 15 kHz (-18 dBFS, drive 18 dB), where one step per 2x sample has its own bar (reference.eco_hf_max_error), under eco's aliasing at that tone. CPU: eco is held to class B on the programme and the +12 dB / drive 24 dB / motion-on worst case; standard and high are reported, over it (their 4x and 8x oversamplers alone take most of the budget), as ADR-0011 3.5 allows beside an eco that meets it. With --cpu-calibrate, eco's p99.9 in reference kernels is also held to p999_kernels x 1.15: its worst measured case, the +12 dB / drive 24 dB / motion-on programme, 139.4 us against a 83.84 us kernel (1.66, i7-11800H). The golden render (its input and settings, standard) is held to the same reference at reference.max_error. brain/research/native-tape-n2.md has the figures.
